shots.beat: The man behind the glass: from behind a grey-haired man in a long coat, Kai beyond the glass. He taps three notes.

camera.focusOn: (()=>{const a=DIR.actor("witness").head.getWorldPosition(new TR.V()), b=DIR.actor("kai").head.getWorldPosition(new TR.V()); const k=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(DIR.t-1.7)/1.0)); const s=k*k*(3-2*k); return a.lerp(b,s);})()

shots.characters: The Witness (back and shoulder only, never his face), Kai behind the glass (in focus)
shots.lighting: Test Hall C lights up on him; the gallery glass reflects; his coat a dark silhouette.
shots.sound: Three notes tapped on the glass (E-B-A), the game's glass voice; then silence.
shots.notes: Spoiler rule: his face and wrist are never in frame. The mission's 'look' clip (it turned his head into profile) is replaced by idle; he keeps his head on Kai, so only the back of his head shows. Focus racks from his grey hair to Kai between shot time 1.7 and 2.7 (under the VO). Taps happen at shot time 1.13, 1.68 and 2.23 s (the game's glass notes), i.e. 69.46, 70.01 and 70.56 s in the edit.

preview.note: Look-dev: over the Witness shoulder (lost profile only, wrist out of frame), focus racks from his grey hair to Kai at the glass. Stills: stills/s19/00012, 00058, 00104.

shots.beat: Montage: Meridian Square at 08:14:00 — commuters under umbrellas and a Continuum trooper stop mid-step, the rain hangs and the square drains of colour; the reset's temporal ripple (back to 08:05) hits on the cut.

setup.eval: import('/src/systems/loops.js').then(m => { const L = m.loopState.active; L.skipTo(535.4); return L.t; })

actions.eval: (() => { const g = __game; let k = 0; const off = g.onUpdate(dt => { k += dt; g.engine.fx.uShift.value = Math.min(0.7, k * 1.8); if (k > 1.2) off(); }); return 1; })()

shots.characters: Seven commuters (citizenLook, umbrellas) walking through the frame at 4-24 m, a second Continuum trooper (Patrol A's look) on patrol by the fountain; all spawned at run time and frozen with the district.
shots.lighting: Rainy morning, the Market Hall's warm windows behind the bronze ring of the fountain; the freeze desaturates to a cold grey.
shots.notes: Camera tracks 2.9 m left at 1.1 m height past the fountain ring toward the Market Hall. The loop is skipped to 535.4 right before frame 0; the game's zero reset freezes the district at loop 538.6 = shot time 3.2 s (uFreeze, freezeAll). At that moment a setup hook also freezes the spawned crowd and holds the rain (the drops shorten into hanging beads, as in mission 1). Action at 4.15 s ramps uShift to 0.7 (the rewind ripple) into the cut. The game's own fade to 08:05 is DOM-only (not captured) and falls in the tail handle. In look-dev a second loop iteration plays the PA cutscene first (game.cine), which delays the reset; the director runs iteration 1, where the storyboard preview showed the freeze on time.

preview.note: Look-dev: commuters cross Meridian Square past the fountain ring, the district freezes at 3.2 s (desaturation, rain held, the trooper stopped mid-step), the rewind ripple builds into the cut. Stills: stills/s20/00012, 00061, 00109.

shots.beat: Montage: Echo Step — Kai sprints at the jammed lockdown shutter; his cyan afterimage holds mid-stride while he slips through.

actions.eval: (()=>{const E=__m12.echo; const ok=E.trigger(); const gh=E.ghost, k=__game.player.char; const col=r=>{const m={}; r.traverse(o=>{if(o.isBone) m[o.name]=o;}); return m;}; const A=col(k.root), B=col(gh.root); let n=0; for(const nm in A){ if(B[nm]){ B[nm].quaternion.copy(A[nm].quaternion); B[nm].position.copy(A[nm].position); n++; } } gh.root.rotation.y=k.root.rotation.y; return [ok,n]; })()

shots.characters: Kai sprinting, his afterimage (holds his sprint pose: the bones are copied at the trigger)
shots.lighting: White lab corridor, the dark shutter with its red lockdown strip and LOCKDOWN sign; the cyan afterimage against the dark shutter.
shots.notes: Setup follows tools/tests/m12.json up to the shutter, then Kai starts a sprint from z -10.5 (Shift+W, 0.3 s before frame 0). Echo Step at shot time 1.1 s (Kai at z -18.3): the afterimage copies his bones so it freezes mid-stride; the dash (0.75 s) arcs him through the shutter, his feet show under the 0.5 m gap on the far side.

preview.note: Look-dev: Kai sprints at the shutter, Echo Step at 1.1 s, the afterimage holds his sprint pose; his feet show under the gap on the far side. Stills: stills/s21/00012, 00040, 00059.

shots.beat: Montage: 2196, the same yards are a battlefield: Unwritten fighters sprint across the rubble while shells arc out of the stabilizer's gold ring and burst in the yard.
shots.characters: Six Unwritten fighters (the mission's UNWRITTEN looks, spawned at run time): two waves sprinting right to left across the yard 6-9 m from the lens and one running the other way, silhouetted against the dusk haze and the bursts.
shots.lighting: Dusk 2196 behind the spire (backlit haze); two shell bursts light the rubble and the fighters (additive glow sprites with a short point-light flash); long HDR tracer streaks.
shots.notes: Low hand-held camera in the no-man's-land (x 4, z 38 to 36.5, 1.3-1.4 m), clear of the crate at x 5-6.5 / z 37.2-37.9 (an earlier path at x 5.5 grazed its top and filled the lower frame with it). Setup: hides the flat RZ.skyline boxes, makes the mission's tracers HDR and stretches them along their velocity into 4-6 m streaks, adds three smoke volumes (W.smokeAt), hides the mission's hard-edged blast spheres and telegraph rings (its own barrage keeps firing tracers), and creates three soft burst sprites + point lights up front (so no shader recompile happens mid-shot). Actions fire six shells out of the return ring (W.tracer; evals return 1, never the tracer object, which made a look-dev evaluate hang) and four bursts across the 2 s cut (0.6 s at (-3, 24), 1.15 s at (9, 20), 1.9 s at (-6, 17), 2.45 s at (5, 27)); the camera pushes in over the full 73 frames. The burst lights reach 16 m, so they light the fighters and the rubble but not the rust wall 1-2 m left of the lens (at 34 m it flared red at the frame edge).

preview.note: Look-dev: low hand-held in the no-man's-land, the spire and its gold ring backlit at dusk, six shells streak out of the ring, four bursts light the yard, two waves of Unwritten fighters sprint across the rubble. Stills: stills/s23/00012, 00028, 00044, 00060 (before the burst-light range was cut from 34 to 16 m).

shots.beat: Montage: Harrow Reach, the city that relives one day: residents cross the Archive Plaza under the stopped public clock, the Lantern's beam rising from the Hollow Archive's copper dome into the hazy morning.
shots.characters: Eight Harrow residents (the mission's RESIDENT survivor looks, spawned at run time) walking across the plaza at 18-40 m; Teo on the plaza edge.
shots.lighting: Hazy 2196 morning, the sun behind the Archive; the Lantern beam brightened at run time (W.beamOn = 3, the mission's own multiplier).
shots.notes: Readiness waits for the 'find' phase (after Sera's intro at the veil), so no intro cinematic runs during the shot. Kai is parked at (40, 0, 30), behind the camera. A slow crane up (3.9 to 4.5 m) and push toward the dome and beam; the stopped public clock (14 MAY 2193) on its post in the middle ground. Residents walk TR.walk paths placed 18-40 m from the lens so whole figures read.

preview.note: Look-dev: the Lantern beam rises out of the copper dome into the hazy sun, residents cross the plaza past the stopped clock; slow crane up. Stills: stills/s26/00012, 00024, 00036.

shots.beat: Montage: the Continuum spire grafted onto the ruin of Helix, dusk, 2196: from the roof of the ruin the camera looks up the pearl spire and its four gold rings, the broken Helix tower in silhouette beside it.

setup.eval: (() => { let n = 0; __game.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh && o.material && o.material.color && o.material.color.getHex() === 0x15181d) { o.visible = false; n++; } }); return n; })()

shots.lighting: Dusk 2196 (the mission's exterior zone: dusk sky environment, warm fog); the gold rings glow against the blue-grey sky, the ruin a dark silhouette.
shots.notes: Kai is parked on the breach ledge (x 118, hidden), which puts the mission in its 'out' zone: the exterior group, dusk environment and fog are on, as in the mission's own opening and ending. The distant flat skyline boxes (RZ.skyline, colour 0x15181d) are hidden at run time. A slow push and tilt up the spire from just above the block's roof (y 16.4, 36 m from the spire): the roof never enters frame.

preview.note: Look-dev: low hero angle up the pearl spire, four gold rings glowing, the broken Helix tower in silhouette at left, dusk sky; slow push and tilt. Stills: stills/s29/00012, 00024, 00035.

shots.beat: Montage: the Sable Yards held in one second: a courier frozen mid-stride in profile on the dawn street, the rain hanging in the air around him; the camera arcs slowly through the drops.
shots.characters: The held courier (frozen mid-stride, in profile, running screen-left), Kai not in frame (at the cordon).
shots.lighting: Grey dawn street; the courier against the lit bookshop windows (warm shelves) and a blue HELIX poster; the held drops catch the light as short streaks.
shots.notes: The front three-quarter orbit was replaced: from the street side the courier reads in clean profile with his legs apart (unmistakably stopped mid-stride) and no bus-shelter pole across the frame. The mission's held rain is sparse (7000 drops over 28 x 7 x 104 m) and its round-ish sprites read as snow up close; a setup eval gives the held rain (and 1400 extra held drops in a 9 m box around the courier, kept 0.9 m clear of the camera path and off his body) a thin vertical streak sprite, so the drops read as rain stopped in the air. A 22-degree linear arc (r 4.3 m) from his flank toward his front, focus on him, lead room ahead of him. The incoming 'switch' warp is left to the edit (as for the other switch shots).

preview.note: Look-dev: the held courier in clean profile, mid-stride, against the lit bookshop windows and a HELIX poster, rain hanging around him as short streaks; slow 22-degree arc through the drops. Stills: stills/s34/00012, 00024, 00035 (rendered at fov 29 / look y 1.05; the approved framing is 2 degrees wider and 7 cm lower for foot room in the 2.39 band).
